comparison.objective: Fit compute blades to a work order and blank every open slot; candidate breaks and recovers HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Blade/blank selection and chassis-slot insertion versus impact-tool alignment, fracture regulation, and fragment handling.
comparison.success_condition: Requested blades installed and all unused slots blanked versus four tangs fractured and contained without disturbing inserts or shell.
comparison.reason: Chassis population tests keyed insertion and completeness, not controlled fracture. The body and specifications are absent, so detailed tolerances and failure guards are unavailable, but the titled objective is clearly different.
